name: Text rendering in generated images v1
description: Six cases whose pictures must contain exact strings — shop signage, a 2K poster, a chalkboard menu, a UI mock, a bilingual sign and one edit that writes a street name onto a blank plate — read back with OCR and scored against the strings the prompt asked for.

eval.notes: An item is correct when every expected string is found after normalisation (NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace, drop punctuation). The character error rate travels next to it in items[].metrics. The OCR backend is part of the measurement and is recorded in workload.resolved_params.ocr_backend; scores from two backends are not comparable, and a run whose backend read nothing at all is a failed measurement rather than a lane that renders no text.

notes: The render shape comes from each row's meta.render, not from params: these are frozen cases, and a case rendered at another size or seed is a different picture. params carries only what is the same for all of them. ocr_backend: auto picks pytesseract when the tesseract binary is present, then rapidocr-onnxruntime, then easyocr. Name one explicitly to compare lanes measured on different machines.
